# Draft:Harshavardhan Rameshwar

Harshavardhan Rameshwar is an Indian music director who works in Telugu, Tamil and Hindi cinema. He is known for his collaborations with Sandeep Reddy Vanga including Arjun Reddy (2017), and Animal. The viral song "Jamal Kudu" from Animal was based on the Iranian song "Jamaal Jamaaloo".
He won the National Film Award for Best Background Music for Animal (2023).
